**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

One of the things I have to do for [M. de Normanville](../persons.html#1088)[^1] is to write a story in French, and [my story](../books.html#1) goes on for ever and ever . . . my poor little girls meet with all sorts of dangers.

[^1]: F. de Normanville (b. 1770/1), her French and Italian teacher, an émigré from the French Revolution.
